title: Black Beast Burned in Omaha, Ga
html_source:
Joyce seems to reference a riot and lynching in Omaha, Nebraska that happened Sep 1919 where the victim was hung, shot and burned. Obviously this wouldn’t appear in a 1904 newspaper.
